result:
All tests pass! I've implemented `InvoiceService.total` which:

1. Checks permission using `_owned()` to ensure only the invoice owner can access it
2. Calculates the subtotal from line items
3. Applies the discount code (if any)
4. Computes GST at 18% (1800 basis points) on the discounted amount
5. Returns the discounted amount plus GST

The implementation correctly handles the formula: **subtotal - discount + GST(discounted_amount)** and enforces permission checks via the service layer as required.
